name: Substance materials (.sbsar)
description: Materials: render Substance archives (.sbsar) into texture sets, choosing a preset and adjusting parameters. Needs Adobe's Substance 3D Integration Tools.

settings.label: Substance engine
settings.hint: The substance_remote_engine program from Adobe's Substance 3D Integration Tools. It is installed with Adobe's Substance add-ons (for Blender, Unity, Unreal and others), normally in the Adobe folder of your user application data.

settings.label: Render with
settings.hint: Automatic uses the graphics card. Choose another only if renders fail. Takes effect the next time the engine starts.

importers.name: sbsar
importers.summary: Render Substance archives (.sbsar) into materials. Needs Adobe's Substance 3D Integration Tools (see: tbx sbsar engine).

options.name: category
options.help: Category of the imported materials.

options.name: name
options.help: Name the material (and so its identity) instead of using the archive's file name, so variants of one archive sit side by side. One archive only; with --all-presets it is the base of <name> - <preset>.

options.name: size
options.help: Texture size in pixels. Default: the plugin's setting (tbx plugin settings com.toybox.material-sbsar size).

options.name: preset
options.help: Start from the archive's preset of this name instead of its defaults (names are listed by: tbx sbsar inputs). Importing the same archive again replaces its material; add --name to keep the earlier one.

options.name: all-presets
options.help: Import every preset of an archive as a material of its own, named <archive> - <preset>.

options.name: graph
options.help: Render this graph of an archive that holds several, by number or label. Default: the first.

options.name: set
options.help: Set a parameter, name=value; repeatable, laid over the defaults or --preset. Numbers, true/false, a list entry by number or label, vectors and colours as 0.2,0.4,0.1 or #rrggbb. A material of the same name is replaced: use --name to keep the earlier one.

options.name: values
options.help: A JSON file of parameter name -> value, applied before any --set.

options.name: ignore-missing
options.help: A parameter an archive does not have is ignored with a warning, instead of skipping that archive.

options.name: skip-existing
options.help: Leave alone an archive whose material the library already has, rendered from the same archive content with the same graph, preset, parameters and size.

options.name: renderer
options.help: Render with the graphics card (auto), Vulkan or the processor, for this run instead of the plugin's setting.

commands.name: sbsar
commands.summary: Work with Substance archives and the materials made from them.

commands.name: inputs
commands.summary: List an archive's graphs, outputs, presets and the parameters you can set, with their types, ranges and choices.

options.name: preset
options.help: Also show the value this preset gives each parameter.

options.name: graph
options.help: Only this graph, by number or label.

options.name: renderer
options.help: Start the engine with this renderer (if it is not running).

commands.name: render
commands.summary: Render Substance materials again with another preset, other parameters or size: in place, or as a new material with --save-as.

options.name: set
options.help: Set a parameter, name=value; repeatable, laid over what the material was rendered with. See: tbx sbsar inputs.

options.name: values
options.help: A JSON file of parameter name -> value, applied before any --set.

options.name: preset
options.help: Start from this preset instead of the material's.

options.name: reset
options.help: Start from the archive's defaults instead of the material's preset and parameters.

options.name: size
options.help: Texture size in pixels. Default: the material's own.

options.name: save-as
options.help: Keep the original and add a new material of this name (one item only).

options.name: ignore-missing
options.help: A parameter a material's archive does not have is ignored with a warning, instead of skipping that material.

options.name: dry-run
options.help: Print what each material would be rendered with and render nothing (the archives are opened in the engine to check the values).

options.name: renderer
options.help: Render with the graphics card (auto), Vulkan or the processor, for this run.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Show how Substance materials were made: archive, graph, preset, changed parameters and size.

commands.name: engine
commands.summary: Check the Substance engine: where it is expected, whether it exists and, with --start, whether it starts and answers.

options.name: start
options.help: Start the engine (stopped again when the command ends) and check that it answers.

options.name: renderer
options.help: Try this renderer instead of the plugin's setting.
